text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I teamed up with Hishi Ama-san and got a 
special steak, yes! Big sis is very good 
at prep work!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So... Sizzling... lean meat... The garlic 
aroma matches it perfectly, too..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Aagh... Hishiama-san... Just... a 
little taste... please... Just one 
percent... just 100 grams..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san. Let's share this steak 
together, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why I thought it'd be nice 
for all of us to eat it together with a 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Because making memories together will be 
waaaay more buono than eating it alone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Since we're at it, I'd love to share 
some with Hishiama-san too... Ah, 
Taiki-san, would that be okay? Our 
portions will be a bit smaller, though—
